title: Monster waving hello
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='26' ry='28' fill='#5cd65c'/>
  <!-- belly patch -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='70' rx='15' ry='17' fill='#a8f0a8'/>
  <!-- spikes on head -->
  <polygon points='36,32 40,20 46,30' fill='#3aa63a'/>
  <polygon points='50,28 54,15 60,28' fill='#3aa63a'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='50' r='8' fill='#fff3f3'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='50' r='8' fill='#fff3f3'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='51' r='4' fill='#2b2b7a'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='51' r='4' fill='#2b2b7a'/>
  <!-- big smile -->
  <path d='M38 64 Q50 78 62 64' stroke='#2b2b7a' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- teeth -->
  <rect x='45' y='63' width='5' height='6' rx='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <rect x='51' y='63' width='5' height='6' rx='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- left arm (down) -->
  <path d='M26 66 Q16 74 18 82' stroke='#3aa63a' stroke-width='9' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- right arm waving -->
  <path d='M74 60 Q86 48 84 36' stroke='#3aa63a' stroke-width='9' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- waving hand -->
  <circle cx='84' cy='33' r='8' fill='#5cd65c'/>
  <!-- little fingers -->
  <circle cx='78' cy='27' r='3.5' fill='#5cd65c'/>
  <circle cx='84' cy='25' r='3.5' fill='#5cd65c'/>
  <circle cx='90' cy='27' r='3.5' fill='#5cd65c'/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='90' rx='11' ry='6' fill='#3aa63a'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='90' rx='11' ry='6' fill='#3aa63a'/>
  <!-- motion lines by waving hand -->
  <path d='M92 30 Q96 28 98 24' stroke='#ffe14d' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M94 38 Q98 38 100 36' stroke='#ffe14d' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
